name: Chicony Power Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Chicony Power Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, manufacturing, and trading of exchange-connected power supplies, electronic components and equipment, LED application products, and smart building systems in Taiwan, Asia, America, Europe, and internationally. It provides adapters, eSports PC, and EV energy conservation, as well as embedded PSUs for a range of industries, including server, cloud, data center, storage, and communications. The company also offers LED backlight modules and automotive lighting for various applications in laptop, PC, smartphone, 3C peripherals, and automotive fields.
